mechanism: Propylthiouracil may cause agranulocytosis and immunosuppression, which could theoretically increase risk of opportunistic infections in HIV patients; additionally, both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism and propylthiouracil hepatotoxicity could affect rilpivirine levels.
action: Monitor CBC regularly; ensure adequate rilpivirine levels with therapeutic drug monitoring if hepatic function changes; consider alternative antithyroid agent (methimazole) if possible.
